clusters.label: Many Viewpoints
clusters.rationale: Distinct principle focused on seeking diverse perspectives with discernment; no other candidate addresses this specific practice.

clusters.label: Close to Action
clusters.rationale: Distinct principle about involving those doing the work; not interchangeable with other decision-making principles.

clusters.label: Root Cause
clusters.rationale: Distinct principle about addressing underlying causes rather than symptoms; no overlap with other specific principles.

clusters.label: Clear Accountability
clusters.rationale: Distinct principle about having an accountable decision-maker; differs from communication or involvement principles.

clusters.label: Balanced Time Horizons
clusters.rationale: Distinct principle about short-term vs. long-term value trade-offs; not the same as root cause or other principles.

clusters.label: Effective Communication
clusters.rationale: Distinct principle about conveying decisions to stakeholders transparently; no other candidate shares this communication focus.

clusters.label: Timely Decisions
clusters.rationale: Distinct principle about prompt decision-making and overcoming delay; unique in its emphasis on timeliness.

clusters.label: Gut vs. Team
clusters.rationale: Distinct principle about balancing intuition with broader team considerations; not merely seeking viewpoints but managing personal instinct.
